chapter: Early years in Brenham and Houston
title: Frank Davis, Camp Kilke party with four governors, and a film
summary: Drummer Frank Davis passes work to the band; they play a resort between Houston and Galveston before four governors, are filmed, and the publicity makes them very busy. Then Harris moves to Waco.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: Yeah. I tell you another fellow was going good then when Dave had his band, a fellow by the name of Frank Davis. He was a drummer, marvelous drummer. And well Frank was getting a lot of work too and we were young and new in the business and Frank would get so much work he couldn't do it, he would throw it our way. That helped us to keep getting a lot of work too. And I remember making a picture, I never get to see that picture. They showed it there at the Queen Theater there in Houston. And we went out to this place called Camp Kilke. Mr. Kirby and his son-in-law Mr. Ratcliffe had a big summer resort out there. I don't know. I don't know whether that was a river or what that was, a big body of water out there. About 30, 40 miles out between Houston and Galveston. And they had yachts and everything, bowling clubs and everything. People just go down there and stay for weekends. And I had a fellow by the name of Jim Wiley who was colored Stewart and ran the place. And whatever deal you made with Stewart, that was it. He paid off. We'd go down there and play three or four days at a time and stay right there in the place and eat and drink and sleep and play. I made this picture. At that time there were four governors attending this party that I played there. If I can remember it was Governor Neff, Governor Hall, Governor Ferguson, and I can't remember the other ones. Four governors were there at the time. I guess it must have been, maybe it must have been Governor Ferguson was the governor and he was impeaching his wife. That's right, tomorrow Ferguson. Tomorrow Ferguson was the governor. So I guess that's where he was. But anyway, the four governors there. And movie stars and everything. Well that kind of publicity just put us smack over man. We just went like wildfire. So after we got it going so strong, old Davis says, look here, we used to use his name. We'll get on the case of court. We'll say, hey, what's your name? We didn't ask you for your name in place. Well he got over it all right. We kept on playing. And I came on over here to back over here to Waco. I got with a bunch.
